svg.title: A workflow that fails on main
svg.desc: A run of a workflow fails on main, in a push, a schedule, a bot or a start by hand. A rerun that failed too shows at once. A first attempt waits unseen for ten minutes, since the bot of the checks reruns the tests and a release. When its rerun passes, nothing shows. Otherwise one message for the workflow comes, which notifies: the jobs that failed, each linked to its log, with Rerun and Ignore. Each run that fails again edits it in place, with how often and when. A run that passes the jobs that failed turns it green, and the next failure opens a new message in its topic.
